rows.label: Pass defense
rows.tip: Rated on every play: EPA allowed per dropback, this season so far (counts 39% now) blended with last season. Higher = softer; rank 1 = toughest of 32. In 2023–25 ESPN’s projection for TEs moved 2.6% per sd of softer pass defense (range +0.4% to +4.8%), so a bigger role has more to move: +0.2 pts per sd on his 9.5 (range 0.0 to +0.5). After ESPN’s number the same rating explained +0.1 pts per sd (range −0.4 to +0.6) for the position: nothing usable. A defense’s rating does predict the next game’s offense EPA (slope 0.57, range 0.31 to 0.87), which is why ESPN already uses it.

bottom.headline: Go with ESPN’s 9.5. The matchup is already in it.
lines: CLE’s pass defense is tough (7th of 32, 1 = toughest). About −0.2 of his 9.5 is that matchup, and a normal week misses by ±6.8.
Once ESPN’s number was counted, the rating still explained +0.1 pts per sd in 2023–25 (range −0.4 to +0.6): nothing to add or subtract.
Not in the number: injury news, teammates who are out, weather. Check those before kickoff.
